'''Kaibe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked for the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] warlord [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] in [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

His torso had been replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]].

When the rogue [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] took control of [[Nym's Factory Compound]] to create [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for his [[Droid Revolution]], Nym enlisted the help of a skilled [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to stop the droid's plans and remove him from the factory. Nym sent the spacer to Kaibe who had already come up with a plan.

Kaibe sent the spacer to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] siblings [[Galody]] and [[Tupit]] who had already scouted out the [[Tao-Ni Security Compound|compound]] of [[Tao-Ni Security]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the company responsible for the factory's security. When the spacer later returned successfully with the needed parts, Kaibe was able to remotely hack into the factory compound's security system. He added the spacer's retinal scans to the system, so the retinal scanners of the factory would allow the spacer and his comrades to enter.

==Behind the scenes==
Kaibe was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Kaibe was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:IG-88|"IG-88" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> After talking to [[Nym's Envoy]], the player was sent to Kaibe, who in turn sent the player to Endor to solve missions for Galody and Tupit. After returning to Lok and talking to Kaibe, the player could access the heroic instance.<ref name="SWG:NS" />
